description: Sample AI responses + the sanitization contract the E2E suite checks delivered entries against (Master Architecture §13 / ContentFilter). Clean samples document the shape StubProvider serves; forbidden patterns are what ContentFilter strips or rejects (meta-mentions, injection attempts, system-prompt leakage) and what any delivered AI entry must never contain.
